# openmetadata_domain (Data Source)

Fetches an OpenMetadata Domain by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openmetadata_domain" "analytics" {
  name = "Analytics"
}

output "domain_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_domain.analytics.id
}

output "domain_type" {
  value = data.openmetadata_domain.analytics.domain_type
}

output "domain_fqn" {
  value = data.openmetadata_domain.analytics.fully_qualified_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the domain to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the domain.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name.
- `domain_type` (String) Type of the domain (Source-aligned, Consumer-aligned, Aggregate).
- `experts` (Attributes List) Subject-matter experts for this domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--experts))
- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name of the domain.
- `id` (String) UUID of the domain.
- `owners` (Attributes List) Owners of this domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owners))
- `parent` (String) Fully qualified name of the parent domain, if any.

<a id="nestedatt--experts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `experts`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) UUID of the expert user.
- `type` (String) Type of the expert entity (user).


<a id="nestedatt--owners"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owners`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) UUID of the owner entity.
- `type` (String) Type of the owner (user or team).
